The three frictions we erase

Lists drove every era of human work. The AI era didn't have one.

Context dies at session boundaries

Your Claude Code todos die in 24 hours. Blitzlist items live forever, in one workspace your agents and teammates can reach.

Artifacts can't move without humans

Files, designs, docs get re-uploaded every session. Blitzbox attachments live in R2, accessible by reference from any MCP client.

AI-to-AI handoff drops state

Claude doesn't know what GPT did last night. Blitzlist is the shared substrate — same MCP server serves every AI client.

I spent my career using lists to channel people's energy toward a shared goal, mark progress, and ship the work — for ProSiebenSat.1's board, at the companies I founded, on the product teams I built. When I started working with AI agents, I noticed the list had disappeared. Every era of work had one. The AI era didn't. So I built Blitzlist.

— Malte Fehr, founder
